GEN.1.orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים אֵת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֵת הָאָרֶץ׃
GEN.1.translit: bərēʾšîṯ bārāʾ ʾĕlōhîm ʾēṯ haššāmayim wəʾēṯ hāʾāreṣ

tr.NATS: Pada mulanya Allah menciptakan langit dan bumi.
tr.KJV: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
tr.WEB: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

GEN.1.note: Kata בָּרָא (bara) dalam PL hanya dipakai dengan Allah sebagai subjek: penciptaan yang khas karya ilahi.

GEN.1.orig: וְהָאָרֶץ הָיְתָה תֹהוּ וָבֹהוּ וְחֹשֶׁךְ עַל־פְּנֵי תְהוֹם וְרוּחַ אֱלֹהִים מְרַחֶפֶת עַל־פְּנֵי הַמָּיִם׃
GEN.1.translit: wəhāʾāreṣ hāyəṯāh ṯōhû wāḇōhû wəḥōšeḵ ʿal-pənê ṯəhôm wərûaḥ ʾĕlōhîm məraḥep̄eṯ ʿal-pənê hammāyim

tr.NATS: Bumi itu belum berbentuk dan kosong; gelap menutupi permukaan samudra raya, dan Roh Allah melayang-layang di atas permukaan air.
tr.KJV: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
tr.WEB: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God's Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

GEN.1.note: Frasa תֹהוּ וָבֹהוּ (tohu wabohu) menggambarkan keadaan belum tertata yang kemudian ditata Allah pada hari-hari penciptaan.

tr.NATS: Lalu Allah berfirman, “Jadilah terang!” Maka terang pun jadi.
tr.KJV: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
tr.WEB: God said, "Let there be light," and there was light.

GEN.1.note: Pola “Allah berfirman … maka jadilah” menegaskan kuasa firman Allah yang mencipta.

PSA.23.orig: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד יְהוָה רֹעִי לֹא אֶחְסָר׃
PSA.23.translit: mizmôr ləḏāwiḏ YHWH rōʿî lōʾ ʾeḥsār

tr.NATS: Mazmur Daud. TUHAN adalah gembalaku, aku tidak akan kekurangan.
tr.KJV: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
tr.WEB: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.

PSA.23.note: Gambaran gembala menekankan pemeliharaan, tuntunan, dan perlindungan.

MAT.5.orig: Μακάριοι οἱ πτωχοὶ τῷ πνεύματι, ὅτι αὐτῶν ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.
MAT.5.translit: Makarioi hoi ptōchoi tō pneumati, hoti autōn estin hē basileia tōn ouranōn.

tr.NATS: Berbahagialah orang yang miskin dalam roh (merasa butuh Allah), karena merekalah pemilik Kerajaan Surga.
tr.KJV: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
tr.WEB: Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

MAT.5.note: Ucapan bahagia pertama dalam Khotbah di Bukit.

JHN.1.orig: Ἐν ἀρχῇ ἦν ὁ λόγος, καὶ ὁ λόγος ἦν πρὸς τὸν θεόν, καὶ θεὸς ἦν ὁ λόγος.
JHN.1.translit: En archē ēn ho logos, kai ho logos ēn pros ton theon, kai theos ēn ho logos.

tr.NATS: Pada mulanya adalah Firman; Firman itu bersama-sama dengan Allah, dan Firman itu adalah Allah.
tr.KJV: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
tr.WEB: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

JHN.1.note: Pembukaan Injil Yohanes sengaja menggemakan Kejadian 1:1 (“Pada mulanya”).

JHN.1.orig: οὗτος ἦν ἐν ἀρχῇ πρὸς τὸν θεόν.
JHN.1.translit: houtos ēn en archē pros ton theon.

tr.NATS: Ia pada mulanya bersama-sama dengan Allah.
tr.KJV: The same was in the beginning with God.
tr.WEB: The same was in the beginning with God.

JHN.1.orig: πάντα δι᾽ αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο, καὶ χωρὶς αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο οὐδὲ ἕν ὃ γέγονεν.
JHN.1.translit: panta di’ autou egeneto, kai chōris autou egeneto oude hen ho gegonen.

tr.NATS: Segala sesuatu dijadikan melalui Dia, dan tanpa Dia tidak ada satu pun yang jadi dari segala yang telah dijadikan.
tr.KJV: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
tr.WEB: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.

JHN.3.orig: Οὕτως γὰρ ἠγάπησεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν κόσμον, ὥστε τὸν υἱὸν τὸν μονογενῆ ἔδωκεν, ἵνα πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων εἰς αὐτὸν μὴ ἀπόληται ἀλλ᾽ ἔχῃ ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
JHN.3.translit: Houtōs gar ēgapēsen ho theos ton kosmon, hōste ton huion ton monogenē edōken, hina pas ho pisteuōn eis auton mē apolētai all’ echē zōēn aiōnion.

tr.NATS: Karena Allah sangat mengasihi dunia ini, Ia memberikan Anak-Nya yang tunggal, supaya setiap orang yang percaya kepada-Nya tidak binasa, tetapi memperoleh hidup kekal.
tr.KJV: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
tr.WEB: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

JHN.3.note: Kata ἀγαπάω (agapaō) menunjuk kasih yang memberi diri.
